lines: ーAnd that was how we had gotten to this point.
Damn it!! They won't give up!!
While turning back, I cut down the demonic creatures who were hot on my heels.
Searching for the separated Hebiko and Shikanosuke...
...Kirara-senpai and I ran deeper into the subway tunnel.
Ohhhh～? Are you alright, Captain? You're already out of breathー
If you can't keep up, shall I run a bit slower for you～?
Kirara-senpai stood ahead of me with a grin and called out.
As with before, her strength and physical capabilities were ridiculous.
She was driving back more than twice as many of the creatures as I was, and yet was running with no discomfort or difficulty breathing, and she even had the energy to taunt me.
I, on the other hand, was giving everything I had in order to not be left behind.
Hmhmm...? Senpai, are you worried about me...? You're surprisingly kind.
But I've been asked to take care of you by Asagi-sensei, so if you die on me I would be in a bit of trouble, you know～?
She did not seem to give a damn about me personally. In a sense, she was a resolute senpai.
Hey, so how about it～? If you say you can't go on anymore, I'll let you have a quick break.
...No, I don't need a break. I'll follow you no matter what.
I replied against my better judgment.
Usually, I wouldn't do something so irrational. It was foolish to push yourself beyond your limits. Butー
(Who's gonna keep quiet after being taunted like that!!?)
Hmmm～? Listen to you♪ Then I'll take you at your wordー
Kirara-senpai chuckled and sped up. The distance between us widened rapidly.
But I couldn't whine at this stage of the game.
I clenched my teeth and followed Kirara-senpai as she sprinted off.
As soon as I felt the sensation of something like a thin, slimy filmー
The next moment, we were standing in a place that was like a strange cave.
